author: faht
body:
Original map by: Haribo98/ParaPenguin.

Tournament version by Eric and Jive:

Images: http://imgur.com/a/fE6ds

Features:
● Water only in middle.
● 2 wools per side.
● Extended frontlines.
● Spawn timer.
● Supplies on roof.
● Can't enter the other team's spawn.
● Many walls before the wool to make it harder for tunnelers.
● Supplies in the woolrooms: Diamond chestplate, 32 golden apples, Power I bow.

Mapdevs/Officials, add Eric on skype for download: eric_mcgamer

Feedback is welcome.
-Eric and Jive.

replies.author: Subscriptor
replies.body:
We extended the front lines and made the middle closer to each side than the original gameplay and put some bow stractures  in frontlines to make bow gameplay from side to side possible.

@Pie: that's what we focused on. Since Senex was all skybridge map plus ground pushers /distracters would just go through spawn and spawn kill,we sdded 2 bridges on both sides, and you can't enter the enemy spawn. If the defender doesn't break them it's fairly easy to get through, it's pretty much balanced. The bridges are just like the sides
thingies in rendez3ctw, they have the same use.another thing we did to prevent sky bridges is putting water only in middle, so they will need people going to middle, and we also extended the middle island by 4 blocks of radius if I'm not wrong.
